paragraphs.text: Masters, render unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
paragraphs.original: οἱ κύριοι, τὸ δίκαιον καὶ τὴν ἰσότητα τοῖς δούλοις παρέχεσθε, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔχετε κύριον ἐν οὐρανῷ.
paragraphs.translit: hoi kyrioi, to dikaion kai tēn isotēta tois doulois parechesthe, eidotes hoti kai hymeis echete kyrion en ouranō.

paragraphs.text: Continue stedfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;
paragraphs.original: Τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτερεῖτε, γρηγοροῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ,
paragraphs.translit: Tē proseuchē proskartereite, grēgorountes en autē en eucharistia,

paragraphs.text: withal praying for us also, that God may open unto us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;
paragraphs.original: προσευχόμενοι ἅμα καὶ περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ὁ θεὸς ἀνοίξῃ ἡμῖν θύραν τοῦ λόγου, λαλῆσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ, διʼ ὃ καὶ δέδεμαι,
paragraphs.translit: proseuchomenoi hama kai peri hēmōn, hina ho theos anoixē hēmin thyran tou logou, lalēsai to mystērion tou Christou, diʼ ho kai dedemai,

paragraphs.text: that I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα φανερώσω αὐτὸ ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.
paragraphs.translit: hina phanerōsō auto hōs dei me lalēsai.

paragraphs.text: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
paragraphs.original: Ἐν σοφίᾳ περιπατεῖτε πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω, τὸν καιρὸν ἐξαγοραζόμενοι.
paragraphs.translit: En sophia peripateite pros tous exō, ton kairon exagorazomenoi.

paragraphs.text: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer each one.
paragraphs.original: ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν πάντοτε ἐν χάριτι, ἅλατι ἠρτυμένος, εἰδέναι πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ ἀποκρίνεσθαι.
paragraphs.translit: ho logos hymōn pantote en chariti, halati ērtymenos, eidenai pōs dei hymas heni hekastō apokrinesthai.

paragraphs.text: All my affairs shall Tychicus make known unto you, the beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow-servant in the Lord:
paragraphs.original: Τὰ κατʼ ἐμὲ πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος καὶ σύνδουλος ἐν κυρίῳ,
paragraphs.translit: Ta katʼ eme panta gnōrisei hymin Tychikos ho agapētos adelphos kai pistos diakonos kai syndoulos en kyriō,

paragraphs.text: whom I have sent you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts;
paragraphs.original: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν,
paragraphs.translit: hon epempsa pros hymas eis auto touto hina gnōte ta peri hēmōn kai parakalesē tas kardias hymōn,

paragraphs.text: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things that [are done] here.
paragraphs.original: σὺν Ὀνησίμῳ τῷ πιστῷ καὶ ἀγαπητῷ ἀδελφῷ, ὅς ἐστιν ἐξ ὑμῶν· πάντα ὑμῖν γνωρίσουσιν τὰ ὧδε.
paragraphs.translit: syn Onēsimō tō pistō kai agapētō adelphō, hos estin ex hymōn· panta hymin gnōrisousin ta hōde.

paragraphs.text: Aristarchus my fellow-prisoner saluteth you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (touching whom ye received commandments; if he come unto you, receive him),
paragraphs.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἀρίσταρχος ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου, καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ ἀνεψιὸς Βαρναβᾶ (περὶ οὗ ἐλάβετε ἐντολάς, ἐὰν ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς δέξασθε αὐτόν),
paragraphs.translit: Aspazetai hymas Aristarchos ho synaichmalōtos mou, kai Markos ho anepsios Barnaba (peri hou elabete entolas, ean elthē pros hymas dexasthe auton),

paragraphs.text: and Jesus that is called Justus, who are of the circumcision: these only [are my] fellow-workers unto the kingdom of God, men that have been a comfort unto me.
paragraphs.original: καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰοῦστος, οἱ ὄντες ἐκ περιτομῆς, οὗτοι μόνοι συνεργοὶ εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, οἵτινες ἐγενήθησάν μοι παρηγορία.
paragraphs.translit: kai Iēsous ho legomenos Ioustos, hoi ontes ek peritomēs, houtoi monoi synergoi eis tēn basileian tou theou, hoitines egenēthēsan moi parēgoria.

paragraphs.text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, saluteth you, always striving for you in his prayers, that ye may stand perfect and fully assured in all the will of God.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ ἐξ ὑμῶν, δοῦλος Χριστοῦ, πάντοτε ἀγωνιζόμενος ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς, ἵνα σταθῆτε τέλειοι καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι ἐν παντὶ θελήματι τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: aspazetai hymas Epaphras ho ex hymōn, doulos Christou, pantote agōnizomenos hyper hymōn en tais proseuchais, hina stathēte teleioi kai peplērophorēmenoi en panti thelēmati tou theou.

paragraphs.text: For I bear him witness, that he hath much labor for you, and for them in Laodicea, and for them in Hierapolis.
paragraphs.original: μαρτυρῶ γὰρ αὐτῷ ὅτι ἔχει πολὺν πόνον ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ τῶν ἐν Ἱεραπόλει.
paragraphs.translit: martyrō gar autō hoti echei polyn ponon hyper hymōn kai tōn en Laodikeia kai tōn en Hierapolei.

paragraphs.text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas salute you.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Λουκᾶς ὁ ἰατρὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς καὶ Δημᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: aspazetai hymas Loukas ho iatros ho agapētos kai Dēmas.

paragraphs.text: Salute the brethren that are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church that is in their house.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ Νύμφαν καὶ τὴν κατʼ οἶκον αὐτῆς ἐκκλησίαν.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe tous en Laodikeia adelphous kai Nymphan kai tēn katʼ oikon autēs ekklēsian.

paragraphs.text: And when this epistle hath been read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye also read the epistle from Laodicea.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὅταν ἀναγνωσθῇ παρʼ ὑμῖν ἡ ἐπιστολή, ποιήσατε ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ Λαοδικέων ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀναγνωσθῇ, καὶ τὴν ἐκ Λαοδικείας ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀναγνῶτε.
paragraphs.translit: kai hotan anagnōsthē parʼ hymin hē epistolē, poiēsate hina kai en tē Laodikeōn ekklēsia anagnōsthē, kai tēn ek Laodikeias hina kai hymeis anagnōte.

paragraphs.text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἴπατε Ἀρχίππῳ· Βλέπε τὴν διακονίαν ἣν παρέλαβες ἐν κυρίῳ, ἵνα αὐτὴν πληροῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai eipate Archippō· Blepe tēn diakonian hēn parelabes en kyriō, hina autēn plērois.

paragraphs.text: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you.
paragraphs.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου. μνημονεύετέ μου τῶν δεσμῶν. ἡ χάρις μεθʼ ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Ho aspasmos tē emē cheiri Paulou. mnēmoneuete mou tōn desmōn. hē charis methʼ hymōn.
